text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Don't be. Thank you for trying your best for my sisters!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That said… you're not the sort to throw in the towel. I'm sure you'll be trying again before long, right?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You'll win one next time, I just know it!
